{{Quote|The ag-producers of the Abrion have lived for decades with few options and limited control of the goods we provide. Now, though, we've found appreciative markets without the restrictive bureaucracy of the Republic.|Esu Rotsino tending Abrion Major's Articles of Secession|<ref name="HNN" />}}
'''Esu Rotsino''', hailing from the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|111|Rotsino, Esu}}</ref> was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the astronomical object [[Abrion Major/Legends|Abrion Major]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="HNN" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|news/13418_1.html|Abrion Sector Secedes; Separatists Get Agri-Worlds}} is set on the date 13:4:18, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], due to ag-producers of the Abrion [[Sector/Legends|sector]] living for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] with minimal options and control of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|goods]] they provided, Rotsino led the entire sector to secede from the Republic to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="HNN" />

When submitting [[Articles of Secession/Legends|Articles of Secession]] to the Senate, Rotsino explained that the Abrion sector's inhabitants felt that the Confederacy were a more appreciative market to their products and that they wished to be freed from the [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] of the Republic. As a result of her actions, the Senate began debating the provision of emergency subsidies to the remaining Republic agricultural sectors, as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region faced the possibility of starvation. Rotsino's statements were later quoted in a 13:4:18 issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] that covered the Abrion sector's secession.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Esu Rotsino was introduced in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 52|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #52'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the HoloNet News<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[April 18]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN52 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6493893|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-04-18|time=6:27 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> Rotsino's name is an anagram of [[Sue Rostoni]], who at the time served as the executive editor for [[Lucas Licensing]].<ref name="Sue Rostoni blog">{{Blog|listing=true|eeusuestornii}}</ref>
